connector.name: TinyFn
connector.registryDescription: 500+ deterministic tools for AI agents: math, conversion, validation, hashing, encoding, date/time.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.tinyfn.io over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace io.tinyfn. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
